text:
erin: Quick heads-up - noticed ~1.9% of yesterday's inbound leads showed up in HubSpot with owner_id = null. Router returned 'no-route' after enrichment lingered ~27s. Can we patch a short-term fallback?

samir: Same. Enrichment p95 spiked to ~50s. Router currently times out at 25s and marks no-route. Sales logged a handful of missed outreach.

ops-bot: Deploy note: enrichment-worker v3.4.0 rolled 04:12 UTC.

debra: Short mitigation idea: small canary feature flag that assigns to an overflow_pool after 18s and sets hs_pending_enrich_ts + hs_handoff_mode so reporting can filter. Add hs_no_sequence to suppress immediate workflows.

yusuf: +1. Also schedule a reconcile job (120s) that will re-evaluate score and transfer ownership safely if enrichment completes. Use header X-Handoff-Origin for SF sync.

helen: SQL audit stub I'll run:
```
SELECT count(*) AS affected, hs_handoff_mode
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
AND owner_id IS NULL
GROUP BY hs_handoff_mode;
```
Posting numbers in 30m.

erin: Action items: samir create feature flag marketing.canary_overflow + PR, debra add HS mappings and suppression, yusuf build reconcile worker, helen run audit. Canary window tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC; auto-disable if fallback_rate > 1% or reconcile_success < 70%. :thumbsup:
